calls.price_at_call: forward P/E just shy of 24x on 2027 earnings growth of 65% expected (stated); analyst average target $375, over 50% upside (stated); definite-buy trigger about 22x forward or lower (stated)
calls.thesis: CONDITIONAL_BUY, first tracked LRCX call for Mark Roussin (no flip) — stock three of four: Lam Research (captions garble it as 'Lamb Research'). He is increasingly interested after a >10% post-earnings sell-off and says 'if it continues to fall into around 22 times or even lower, I'm definitely buying before 2027.'
calls.base_case: September quarter revenue about $8.2bn, up about 54% YoY, adjusted EPS $2.20, operating margins about 40% — record revenue and profitability; biggest customers Micron, SK Hynix and TSMC are all rushing to add capacity; Edge score 78, shares still up 51% over 12 months.
calls.bull_case: More complex chips need more etching/deposition equipment, so AI chip demand directly creates equipment demand; capacity, not demand, is the bottleneck for its customers.
calls.bear_case: December guidance about $8.6bn disappointed versus expectations; supply-chain constraints may limit near-term shipments, and China was about 35% of September revenue with that share expected to decline significantly in December.
